cspell.description: Add English and Brazilian Portuguese spell checking.

env.description: Add a typed environment-variable contract (.env.example plus validation dependencies).
notes: Centralize and validate environment reads before startup (e.g. @t3-oss/env-core + zod): export typed values from a single module and consume them across the app. .env is gitignored; .env.example documents the contract.

secrets.description: Add a local gitleaks secret-scanning gate wired into the pre-commit hook.
notes: gitleaks is an external binary: when missing, the gate is skipped with a warning and CI covers the whole repository. Install it to enable local scanning.

format.description: Add Prettier-based formatting for Markdown and shell scripts alongside Biome.

scripts.format: biome format --write . && {{packageManager}} run format:md && {{packageManager}} run format:sh

notes: This tool replaces the base `format` script with one that also formats Markdown and shell files via Prettier; approve the package.json#/scripts/format collision to apply.

docker.description: Add a multi-stage Dockerfile (Bun runtime, non-root user) and .dockerignore for containerized deployments.
notes: The Dockerfile uses bun build --target bun so the runtime image contains only the self-contained bundle, running as the non-root `bun` user.

lint-staged.description: Format, type-check, and test only staged files before commit.
notes: The pre-commit hook detects .lintstagedrc.js and runs lint-staged automatically; no separate hook script is needed.
